title: Rishikesh Madi Tripathi v. State of U.P. and Another
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, J. and Kshitij Shailendra, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; petitioner directed to file Clause 6.5 objection
headnote: A consumer's writ seeking restoration of a 2 KW sanctioned meter load, correction of the outstanding bill, and installment payment is disposed of by directing him to file an application/objection under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. If filed within two weeks, the authority shall decide it within six weeks after hearing.
facts: The petitioner, a consumer of Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited at Gorakhpur, sought a mandamus directing the Executive Engineer, Electricity Urban Distribution Division, Taramandal, to restore and correct his electricity meter to the originally sanctioned load of 2 KW, recalculate the outstanding bill, and allow him to deposit the dues in easy installments. After notice and dasti service on 3 March 2025, the Division Bench heard both sides on 18 March 2025.

holding_units.holding: The writ is disposed of by directing the petitioner to file an application/objection under Clause 6.5 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005; if filed within two weeks, the authority concerned shall decide it within six weeks of filing after granting the petitioner an opportunity of hearing.

not_decided.point: Whether the meter should be restored to the originally sanctioned 2 KW load, the outstanding bill recalculated, and dues allowed in installments
